title: Wire processor createEditor to real editor
description:
Modify Source/PluginProcessor.cpp only.

Minimal change: update createEditor() so it returns the real PluginEditor (e.g. return std::make_unique<PluginEditor>(*this);) instead of a generic juce::GenericAudioProcessorEditor or temporary stub. Add #include "PluginEditor.h" if missing. Do not change processBlock, APVTS layout, prepareToPlay, state save/restore, or any other processor logic.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (current createEditor implementation from phases a/e)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h
- Source/PluginEditor.h (constructor signature from h.1)

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/PluginProcessor.cpp. Keep the diff minimal — createEditor swap and necessary include only.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.cpp createEditor() returns PluginEditor for this processor
No APVTS, DSP, or processBlock logic is changed beyond createEditor wiring
cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja && cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone completes with exit code 0
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change createParameterLayout or any parameter IDs
edit processBlock, prepareToPlay, or bus layouts

allowed: swap createEditor return type to PluginEditor
